pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tapode nhāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.3: athakho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro sīsaṃ nhāyissāmīti tapodaṃ gantvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.4: yāva ayyā nhāyantīti ekamantaṃ paṭimānesi. bhikkhū yāva samandhakārā nhāyiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.5: athakho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro vikāle sīsaṃ nhāyitvā nagaradvāre thakkite bahinagare vasitvā kālasseva asambhinnena vilepanena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ bhagavā etadavoca kissa tvaṃ mahārāja kālasseva āgato asambhinnena vilepanenāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.8: athakho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.9: athakho bhagavā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi. athakho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.10: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū rājānaṃpi passitvā na mattaṃ jānitvā nhāyantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.14: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā rājānaṃpi passitvā na mattaṃ jānitvā nhāyissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.15: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu orenaḍḍhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:1.18: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū uṇhasamaye pariḷāhasamaye kukkuccāyantā na nhāyanti sedagatena gattena sayanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave uṇhasamaye pariḷāhasamaye orenaḍḍhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.5: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu orenaḍḍhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānanti vassānassa paṭhamo māso iccete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:2.8: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.4: pubbe mayaṃ āvuso orenaḍḍhamāsaṃ nhāyāma tena no phāsu hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.5: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittanti kukkuccāyantā na nhāyāma tena no na phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā orenaḍḍhamāsaṃ nhāyituṃ

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ajjhokāse cīvarakammaṃ karontā sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti devo ca thokaṃ thokaṃ phussi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.2: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā na nhāyanti kilinnena gattena sayanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.6: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.7.1: yo pana bhikkhu orenaḍḍhamāsaṃ nhāyeyya aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:6.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānanti vassānassa paṭhamo māso iccete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayo gilānasamayo kammasamayo addhānagamanasamayo vātavuṭṭhisamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.8: cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā nhāyati. payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.15: vassānassa paṭhamo māso. iccete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayoti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.17: yassa vinā nhānena na phāsu hoti. gilānasamayoti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.19: antamaso pariveṇaṃpi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti. kammasamayoti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.21: aḍḍhayojanaṃ gamissāmīti nhāyitabbaṃ gacchantena nhāyitabbaṃ gatena nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.1.23: bhikkhū sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni kāye patitāni honti. vātavuṭṭhisamayoti nhāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.2.1: ūnakaḍḍhamāse ūnakasaññī aññatra samayā nhāyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.2.2: ūnakaḍḍhamāse vematiko aññatra samayā nhāyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc57:7.2.3: ūnakaḍḍhamāse atirekasaññī aññatra samayā nhāyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
